Subject: Post-call: SDK auth & routing playbook — Integratek integration

Thanks for the demo and the deep-dive earlier today, Sam — good to meet the Integratek infra team. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we stay aligned on scope and timing.

Key takeaways (agreed on the call)
- Primary integration: Integratek will use Redwood hosted API for embeddings + reranker, with a short-term Dedicated pilot for high-throughput scoring.
- Main blocker observed: intermittent 502/5xx from your routing layer when payloads include dense embeddings + structured-tool calls.
- Auth: Integratek will use service account tokens scoped to /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings; they asked for a short-lived token flow example.

What Redwood will do (owners in parens)
- Share a concise SDK auth playbook (examples for service-account token exchange + curl) and curated timeout/streaming settings (Marissa).
- Provide a reproducible payload + quick repro steps that match the 5xx you saw (Priyom).
- Run a short reproduction in our staging to validate routing fallbacks and suggest timeout tuning (Ben).

Attachments: I attached the high-level MVP playbook (mvp-playbook.pdf) and will attach the repro payload once Priyom confirms.

Proposed immediate next steps
1) Priyom to send the concise repro payload + curl (today EOD).
2) Ben to attempt reproduce in staging and report whether the failure is on model runtime vs routing (tomorrow morning).
3) Schedule 60-min technical working session — Wed 18 Feb 2027 10:00 AM PST (please confirm).

Thanks — Marissa

Thanks Marissa — confirm Wed 10am PST works for us. A couple of clarifications from our side and quick context to help reproduce:

Observed behavior
- We see intermittent 502 responses returned by our API gateway when the client request body exceeds ~256KB. The error chain shows Redwood returning 5xx downstream in that window.
- Example error snippet from our gateway: {"status":502, "upstream_error":"read timeout", "upstream_host":"redwood-prod-2"}.

What would help us reproduce quickly
- The exact raw request payload (we'll sanitize PII before sharing) — we can try to replay.
- Token exchange example; currently we're using a long-lived key and would like to switch to short-lived tokens if that reduces surface area.

I'll attach a small trace from our gateway (network-trace-2027-02-17.txt) — it's a trimmed capture. We'll share more logs if needed during the tech session.

Looping in my quick triage notes before the working session. I pulled the trace Sam sent and ran a couple of local replays against our staging frontends. Findings so far:

Preliminary hypothesis
- Gateway timeouts (upstream read timeout) look correlated with payload size spikes and simultaneous KV cache warm-ups on the model nodes. When clients send large embedding batches + tool calling metadata, the per-request processing jumps and the routing proxy sometimes exhausts its default 30s window.

Immediate mitigations to try
- Increase client-side timeout to 60s (curl --max-time 60) and default gateway upstream timeout to 90s for the Integratek route.
- Enable chunked transfer encoding for large embedding uploads to keep upstream connections alive.
- Suggest using the model variant header to pin a lower-latency variant for scoring heavy requests: X-Redwood-Model-Variant: low-latency-8q (we'll confirm exact name in the tech session).

I'll attempt a reproduce in staging this morning and upload repro artifacts to the shared Drive link. Priyom — if you can send the sanitized curl and payload now we can start.

-ben

--
Ben Carter

Attached the sanitized repro payload and a minimal curl that reproduces the 502 on our side. Also included a small variant that uses streaming to show the difference.

Attachment: redwood_repro_payload.json

Repro steps
1) Save payload to payload.json
2) curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <SHORT_LIVED_TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @payload.json "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate" --max-time 45 -o response.json

Optional (streams):
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <SHORT_LIVED_TOKEN>" -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" --data-binary @payload.json "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate?stream=true" --max-time 90 -o response_stream.json

Notes
- The payload uses a combined embeddings + tool_call body that hits the score/rerank path. We included header X-Redwood-Model-Variant: low-latency-8q in the example.
- If you get a 502 in staging, capture the full upstream headers and share. Forwarding Sam's trace below for continuity.
